headline: Sensex and Nifty Volatile as IT Stocks Drag; SpiceJet Under Scrutiny and NSE IPO Sees Strong Interest

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT sector weakness led to a decline in major indices, with Nifty falling below 23,350
The DGCA has initiated operational and financial audits on SpiceJet
The NSE IPO concluded its final day with a strong 6x subscription rate
Volatility is expected due to persistent US inflation risks and global economic cues
whatHappening: Internal tensions at Tata Sons and Tata Trusts were reported regarding a potential casting vote clash
Steel prices have reached a four-year high, impacting industrial sectors
India has launched anti-dumping investigations into Glycine chemical imports from China
PhonePe secured approval for two payment licenses from the UAE central bank
summary: The Indian stock market is navigating volatility as IT stocks drag the Nifty below 23,350, while SpiceJet faces regulatory audits by the DGCA. Investor interest remains high in the primary market, with the NSE IPO concluding with a 6x subscription. Global factors, including US inflation risks and crude oil price corrections, continue to influence domestic sentiment.
